# couchbase-capella_database_role (Resource)

Resource to create and manage a database user role for a cluster. Database roles define reusable sets of privileges that can be assigned to database credentials.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access))
- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.
- `name` (String)
- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the project.

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Attributes) Couchbase audit data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
